messages:
zach: Heads-up: I put a compact release-note draft in the team doc: https://docs.google.com/r/RELEASE_1_14_DRAFT. Need a short pin for the internal channel and ops signoff on canary. Target internal pin at 2025-05-10 16:00 PT.

claire: I can write the one-liner. What exact rollback window do we want called out?

zach: 90 minutes from publish. Also we should pin the exact version string (1.14.0) and the commit hash so support can reference it.

pm-raj: From product: no user-visible UI changes. Please mention routing/KV improvements and a note about improved quantization for the heavy-traffic models.

claire: Draft pin (short):
"Release 1.14.0 (commit abc1234) — no user-facing UI changes. Improves KV cache throughput and routing fallback. Canary rollout 10%→50%→100%. Rollback window: 90m. Runbook: <link>."

oncall-amber: Ops signoff: standby 15:30-18:00 PT. Canary plan: 10% for 10m, 50% for 25m, then 100% if green. Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 increase +200ms for 5m. Runbook has commands: `ops rollback --to v1.13.9` and `ops pin-release --version 1.13.9` ready.

zach: Good. Also want deploybot to pin the doc and tag @oncall-amber on publish. Can we queue that?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: OK. Use this command to queue and pin on publish:
```
/deploy schedule_publish --channel "eng-releases" --when "2025-05-10T16:00:00-07:00" --message "[Internal] Release 1.14.0 live (pin will follow)" --pin yes --tag @oncall-amber --meta version=1.14.0 commit=abc1234
```
React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

doc-bot: Quick suggestion: include a brief bullet list in the pinned doc for SRE/Support checklist (dashboard links, query snippets). I can add a short section if you want.

claire: Confirmed. I'll add the support checklist and merge pm-raj's microcopy.

oncall-amber: Please include the canary dashboard link and the deploy stream logs in the checklist. I'll monitor and post status here.

zach: All set. Claire will post final blurb and run the deploybot command. Final note: pin the internal doc (not the external RN) so the pinned message contains the runbook link and dashboard links.

claire: Final one-liner to post (for internal pin):
"Release 1.14.0 (abc1234) — user-facing behavior unchanged. KV cache + routing fallback improvements. Canary: 10%→50%→100% over 35m. Rollback window: 90m. Runbook + dashboards: <internal links>."

deploy-bot: Scheduled and pinned: post queued for 2025-05-10T16:00:00-07:00 in #eng-releases. I will tag @oncall-amber on publish and attach the pinned doc.

oncall-amber: Acknowledged. I'll report back in this thread if anything looks off during canary.

zach: Thanks all — closing the loop. If rollback happens, please post the `ops rollback` command output here so we can capture timing for postmortem.
